answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The inlet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Every claim climbs the hollow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tundra re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
